title: Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz
shortDescription: Confront the capricious Wizard of Frobozz.
description: At the far end of an ancient barrow, a faint light leads deeper underground. Your lantern and sword are close at hand. Beyond the tunnel lie the Wizard of Frobozz and the troublesome spells he casts on passing adventurers. Explore his domain and find a way past the obstacles his magic leaves in your path.
author: Infocom

reviews.author: wizard_watcher
reviews.title: A worthy successor
reviews.body: The Wizard of Frobozz is one of gaming's great characters. Unpredictable, hilarious, and occasionally helpful — he makes this game unforgettable.

reviews.author: dungeon_diver
reviews.title: Tougher than Zork I
reviews.body: The puzzles here are harder and more abstract. The Carousel Room alone is a rite of passage for any text adventure fan.
